name: app-black-team-quote-circles-with-glow-points
title: Black Team Quotes on Dark Circles
whatItIs: A black slide with three huge barely visible dark circles, each holding a team member's avatar, name, role and quote with a few phrases in white and the rest grey, anchored by small lime glow points.
whatItMeans: Almost invisible circles group content softly, and lime glow dots add a sense of connection between voices.
techniques: Highlight key phrases in white within grey text
Glow dots at circle contacts as connectors
Small avatar with name and role above each quote

vocabulary.definition: A container so subtle it barely separates content from the background.
Making selected words brighter than the rest.
A small luminous dot used as a connector or marker.
